hypothesis: Some overlapping geometric candidates have incorrect CORE-distance ownership even though independent cached RGB-D masks support exactly one candidate's identity at the disputed surface. Preserve candidate quality/NMS and arbitrate only those disputed points by unique independent positive identity evidence.

policy.candidate_selection: Existing proposal_ensemble agreement q and IoU>.5 NMS, minimum_points=100, unchanged
policy.native_identity: Existing validated track observations map original frame IDs to original local mask IDs; no names/classes as equality rules
policy.peer_identity: A frame's dominant nonzero original mask on the candidate uncontested observed core (whole observed candidate only when core<16), >=32 positive points and >=.7 of depth-visible core
policy.point_arbitration: Exactly one competing candidate has positive identity support in at least two cameras separated >=.15m; otherwise preserve CORE owner
policy.unknown: Occluded/unobserved/background-unannotated pixels contribute no positive support, no negative count, and never prove nonexistence
policy.publication: Original unlabeled geometric segment >.5 majority for ScanNet; none invented for Hypersim010

risks: Cached source identity may already merge different physical objects; positive evidence can repeat that source failure.
Core-to-frame identity association can be wrong for a broad peer; two positive views are evidence, not calibrated correctness.
Few-view instances and unknown surfaces cannot gain an override; suppressed proposals cannot be recovered under unchanged NMS.
ScanNet majority publication can absorb small point-level improvements or amplify a mistaken boundary move.
The frozen 010 domain/peer has a severe q/NMS regression that ownership alone may not fix.
domains: All four items of ../four_domain_confirmation_registration.json, same manifests, source, peer and physical representation
acceptance: Independent unchanged native point-mask AP25/AP50/mean for all four domains, compare same-geometry CORE control plus v19/ESAM references; mask screen cannot justify production upgrade or new 010 strict-box claim
